title: AI’s impact on economies and societies
discussion_signal: UNDP frames AI as capable of widening inequalities between countries while offering pathways for shared human development. A visible reaction emphasizes unemployment, weak regulation, security, and vulnerable countries, showing how agency and divergence concerns are interpreted through distribution and control.
linked_research_question: How can AI expand human agency and development capacity without deepening dependence, inequality, and loss of public control?
limits: Institutional announcement and one visible reaction
